Restricted functional repeated-measures moments and residual dependence diagnostics

etr_native_functional_mixed_moments.Rd

Seven Python-free numerical R implementations covering a restricted two-level functional method-of-moments fixed-effects model, covariance-conditional participant random functions, within-curve whitening, exact residual lag diagnostics, residual pairs and source-shaped coefficient/variance auditing.

Usage

etr_fit_functional_mixed_effects_regression(trajectories, design, predictors,
  participant_column, dimension, covariance_ridge = 1e-6)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_whitened_residuals(result)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_residual_diagnostics(result, max_lag,
  residual_scale = "raw")
etr_functional_mixed_effects_residual_diagnostic_frame(result, level = "trial",
  curve_id = NULL, participant_id = NULL)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_residual_pair_frame(result, lag_index,
  curve_id = NULL, participant_id = NULL)
etr_functional_mixed_effects_coefficient_frame(result, band = NULL)

Arguments

trajectories

Complete native common-grid trajectory set with a selected non-simplex outcome channel.

design

One complete numeric predictor row per source curve, aligned by unique curve_id.

predictors

Unique names of finite numeric scalar fixed predictors; may be empty for intercept-only.

participant_column

Metadata field supplying complete participant identities; requires at least 3 participants with at least 2 curves each.

dimension

One explicit response dimension name.

covariance_ridge

Positive covariance regularization proportion in (0,1).

result

Restricted two-level moments fit or its residual diagnostic object as appropriate. Native joint B-spline Gaussian likelihood fits are also accepted by whitening, lag diagnostics, residual pair, and coefficient frame functions. The joint models retain observed time units, source curve IDs, and their fitted conditional covariance without model refitting.

max_lag

Explicit positive index lag strictly less than the number of time points.

residual_scale

Raw or within-trial covariance-whitened conditional residuals.

level

Trial, participant or overall audit-frame aggregation.

curve_id

Optional trial/curve filter where supported.

participant_id

Optional participant filter where supported.

lag_index

Explicit integer lag within the declared maximum.

band

Not supported; only NULL is accepted. No simultaneous mixed-model bands are qualified.

Value

A restricted two-level functional model object, whitened residual matrix, diagnostic result, physical-lag residual pair data frame, variance decomposition, or coefficient table.

Details

Critical restriction: this model is NOT the spline-based statsmodels MixedLM, Gaussian profiled GLS or REML backend in eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0. Fixed coefficient functions are independently estimated pointwise with participant-cluster sandwich standard errors. Participant random functions use PSD-projected two-level covariance method-of-moments shrinkage with a declared ridge. Participant covariance and interval calibration are not certified. Random slopes, nested trial effects, residual AR1/exponential correlation likelihood optimization, and simultaneous bands are not provided. The source-ordered coefficient-frame adapter accepts fitted native joint B-spline likelihood objects without a refit. The new likelihood-residual adapter computes physical-lag audit frames from conditional residual functions and covariance-based whitening; it does not change the restricted moment model's estimator or numerical formulas. This distinction is retained in the residual diagnostic provenance. The public name mapping is partial source-contract support, never one-to-one equivalence.
